BANK.name: Request Bank Party Identification
BANK.definition: Bank party identification is requested. This is a unique and unambiguous assignment made by a specific bank or similar financial institution to identify a relationship as defined between the bank and its client.

CBID.name: Request Central Bank Identification Number
CBID.definition: Central bank identification number is requested. This is a unique identification number assigned by a central bank to identify an organisation.

CHID.name: Request Clearing Identification Number
CHID.definition: Clearing identification number is requested. This is a unique identification number assigned by a clearing house to identify an organisation

CINC.name: Request Certificate Of Incorporation Number
CINC.definition: Certificate of incorporation number is requested. This is a unique identification number assigned by a designated authority to a certificate of incorporation and used to identify an organisation.

COID.name: Request Country Identification Code
COID.definition: Country identification code is requested. This is a country authority given organisation identification (e.g., corporate registration number)

CUST.name: Request Customer Number
CUST.definition: Customer number is requested. This is a number assigned by an issuer to identify a customer or a number assigned by a party to identify a creditor or debtor relationship.

DUNS.name: Request Data Universal Numbering System
DUNS.definition: Data universal number is requested. This is a unique identification number provided by Dun & Bradstreet to identify an organisation.

GS1G.name: Request GS 1 GLN Identifier
GS1G.definition: GS1GLN (Global location number) identifier is requested. This is a non-significant reference number used to identify legal entities, functional entities, or physical entities according to GS1 numbering scheme rules.The number is used to retrieve detailed information that is linked to it.

SREN.name: Request SIREN
SREN.definition: SIREN number is requested. This is a 9 digit code assigned by INSEE, the French National Institute for Statistics and Economic Studies, to identify an organisation in France.

SRET.name: Request SIRET
SRET.definition: SIRET number is requested. This is a 14 digit code assigned by INSEE, the French National Institute for Statistics and Economic Studies, to identify an organisation unit in France. It consists of the SIREN number, followed by a five digit classification number, to identify the local geographical unit of that entity

BDID.name: Request Business Domain Identifier

BOID.name: Request Business Other Identification
